one_liner: Size and configure multi-GPU/multi-node LLM serving using tensor, pipeline, expert, and data parallelism.

key_terms.definition: Splits weight matrices column/row-wise across GPUs within a layer, needing an all-reduce per split; lowers per-GPU memory and can reduce latency.
Splits a model's layers into sequential stages across devices linked by peer-to-peer activation transfers; mainly a memory-capacity and throughput tool, latency-neutral for decode.
Spreads Mixture-of-Experts weights across devices so each GPU hosts a subset of experts, requiring all-to-all dispatch and gather collectives per MoE layer.
Extends expert parallelism across multiple nodes over InfiniBand rather than confining it to one NVLink node, enabling much larger EP degrees for huge MoE models.
Independent, identical (possibly TP/PP-sharded) copies of the model each serving separate requests; scales throughput linearly with replica count and adds no communication overhead.
A blocking collective that sums partial tensor results across ranks and returns the total to every rank; recombines row-parallel TP outputs each layer.
A collective where each rank exchanges distinct data with every other rank; used in EP to dispatch tokens to expert-holding GPUs and gather outputs back.
The inference phase that processes the entire input prompt in one compute-bound forward pass before token generation begins.
The inference phase generating one token per step; memory-bandwidth-bound and uniquely sensitive to per-step communication latency from parallelism strategies.
The latency to produce each subsequent decode-step token; the metric against which TP, PP, EP, and DP are judged for interactive latency-critical serving.
The fraction of a GPU's peak FLOPs actually achieved; high (40-60%) during compute-bound prefill, low (5-15%) during memory-bandwidth-bound small-batch decode.
The failure mode where a small decode batch under expert parallelism leaves most expert GPUs idle while the all-to-all cost is still paid, wasting the cluster.

prerequisites: GPU architecture and interconnects (NVLink, PCIe, InfiniBand)
prefill and decode phases of inference and the KV cache
tensor and pipeline parallelism fundamentals from distributed training
